content.text:
The product search index is rebuilt every hour from a full export. The rebuild takes 40 minutes, and new products stay invisible for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets about missing products in July 2026.

Source: `specs/search-index-rewrite.md`, the opening problem paragraph. The proposal fixes this by indexing incrementally from the `products.events` stream, so products become searchable within 30 seconds.
